summary.text: Bill Heughins is the Democratic candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 43, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he is running against incumbent Greg Howard (R).
His campaign website describes him as a social studies teacher in North Stonington.

paragraphs.text: Heughins' campaign website says he has lived in Pawcatuck since 1998, has coached his daughters' teams, and is running to represent Ledyard, Stonington and North Stonington.
The site says he has taught for nearly 30 years in the district's schools.

According to his campaign website, Heughins' priorities include changing the state education funding formula so schools are fully funded without added local property taxes, lowering electricity and other cost-of-living burdens, and affordable access to health care.
Ballotpedia lists the Connecticut AFL-CIO among his endorsements.
